title: Exercise 8: Sentence Building from Cues
instruction: Use the given cue words to write grammatically complete and meaningful sentences using verbs with prepositions and relative clauses.
target_grammar: Verbs with prepositions, Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence

questions.cues: Many / eco-conscious / families / turn off / unnecessary / appliances / which / prevent / waste of electricity
questions.correct_answer: Many eco-conscious families turn off unnecessary appliances, which prevents a waste of electricity.
acceptable_answers: Many eco-conscious families turn off unnecessary appliances, which prevents a waste of electricity.
questions.explanation: Thêm mạo từ và chia động từ: 'turn off' (hiện tại đơn số nhiều) và 'prevents' (chia số ít sau ', which').

questions.cues: Households / should / rinse out / dirty / takeaway container / before / throw / it / recycling bin
questions.correct_answer: Households should rinse out a dirty takeaway container before throwing it into the recycling bin.
acceptable_answers: Households should rinse out a dirty takeaway container before throwing it into the recycling bin.
Households should rinse out a dirty takeaway container before throwing it in the recycling bin.
questions.explanation: Cụm động từ 'rinse out', sau 'before' dùng danh động từ 'throwing', thêm giới từ 'into the recycling bin'.

questions.cues: The school / start / compost / each / fruit peel / garden waste / which / provide / organic fertiliser / plant pot
questions.correct_answer: The school started composting each fruit peel and garden waste, which provides organic fertiliser for each plant pot.
acceptable_answers: The school started composting each fruit peel and garden waste, which provides organic fertiliser for each plant pot.
The school has started composting each fruit peel and garden waste, which provides organic fertiliser for each plant pot.
questions.explanation: 'started composting', liên từ 'and', đại từ ', which' đi với động từ số ít 'provides', giới từ 'for each plant pot'.

questions.cues: Volunteers / succeed / clean up / plastic litter / along / canal / which / protect / wild animals / harm
questions.correct_answer: Volunteers succeeded in cleaning up plastic litter along the canal, which protected wild animals from harm.
acceptable_answers: Volunteers succeeded in cleaning up plastic litter along the canal, which protected wild animals from harm.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'succeeded in cleaning up', mạo từ 'the canal', ', which' và 'protected wild animals from harm'.

questions.cues: The company / commit / eliminate / single-use / packaging / which / contribute / sustainable / green living
questions.correct_answer: The company committed to eliminating single-use packaging, which contributes to sustainable green living.
acceptable_answers: The company committed to eliminating single-use packaging, which contributes to sustainable green living.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'committed to eliminating', đại từ ', which', động từ 'contributes to sustainable green living'.

questions.cues: Using / public transport / instead / private / cars / lower / carbon emissions / which / combat / climate change
questions.correct_answer: Using public transport instead of private cars lowers carbon emissions, which combats climate change.
acceptable_answers: Using public transport instead of private cars lowers carbon emissions, which combats climate change.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ danh động từ 'Using... lowers', cụm 'instead of', đại từ ', which' và động từ số ít 'combats climate change'.

questions.cues: The factory / apologise / dispose / toxic / chemical pollutants / local / landfill
questions.correct_answer: The factory apologised for disposing of toxic chemical pollutants into the local landfill.
acceptable_answers: The factory apologised for disposing of toxic chemical pollutants into the local landfill.
The factory apologised for disposing of toxic chemical pollutants in the local landfill.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'apologised for disposing of' và thêm mạo từ 'the local landfill'.

questions.cues: Students / craft / charming / bird feeder / discarded / cardboard box / which / impress / their / biology teacher
questions.correct_answer: Students crafted a charming bird feeder from a discarded cardboard box, which impressed their biology teacher.
acceptable_answers: Students crafted a charming bird feeder from a discarded cardboard box, which impressed their biology teacher.
questions.explanation: Chia thì quá khứ đơn 'crafted a charming bird feeder from a discarded cardboard box', mệnh đề ', which' bổ nghĩa cho cả câu.

questions.cues: Transitioning / green energy / lower / greenhouse gas emissions / which / benefit / planet / long run
questions.correct_answer: Transitioning to green energy lowers greenhouse gas emissions, which benefits our planet in the long run.
acceptable_answers: Transitioning to green energy lowers greenhouse gas emissions, which benefits our planet in the long run.
Transitioning to green energy lowers greenhouse gas emissions, which benefits the planet in the long run.
questions.explanation: 'Transitioning to green energy lowers...', đại từ ', which' đi với 'benefits our planet in the long run'.

questions.cues: Installing / sensor tap / restroom / save / clean water / which / demonstrate / high / environmental awareness
questions.correct_answer: Installing a sensor tap in each restroom saves clean water, which demonstrates high environmental awareness.
acceptable_answers: Installing a sensor tap in each restroom saves clean water, which demonstrates high environmental awareness.
questions.explanation: 'Installing a sensor tap in each restroom saves...', mệnh đề ', which' đi với 'demonstrates high environmental awareness'.
